en.headline: Weekend outlook: sunny, dry and very hot for Mid-Autumn holiday
en.dek: The Observatory forecasts mainly fine weather with light winds and temperatures reaching 33 to 34 degrees on Saturday and Sunday, under the influence of an anticyclone aloft.
body: Hong Kong is set for a sunny, dry and very hot weekend as the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday continues, according to the latest nine-day forecast issued by the Hong Kong Observatory.

On Saturday, light winds of force 2 are expected with sunny periods. It will be dry and very hot during the day, with mainly cloudy conditions in the morning and at night. Temperatures are forecast to range from 28 to 33 degrees Celsius, and relative humidity between 60 and 90 per cent.

Sunday looks mainly fine, remaining dry and very hot during the day under light force 2 winds. The temperature range is 28 to 34 degrees, with humidity 55 to 85 per cent. An anticyclone aloft will cover Guangdong early to mid next week, keeping winds weak and the weather generally fine, though inland areas may become extremely hot.

Tropical Cyclone Surigae is expected to intensify and move towards seas east of Taiwan and the Ryukyu Islands before turning northeast towards waters south of Japan. It is not expected to affect Hong Kong directly. A yellow fire danger warning remains in force, and the public is advised to take precautions against heat stroke while outdoors.
The Observatory notes that another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected later next week, bringing a few showers and some relief from the high temperatures.

zh.headline: 周末天氣展望：中秋連假天晴乾燥酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六及周日大致天晴，吹微風，日間乾燥酷熱，氣溫升至33至34度，受高空反氣旋影響。
body: 香港天文台最新九天天氣預報顯示，中秋節連假周末本港天氣大致天晴乾燥，並會酷熱。
周六吹微風，風力2級，有陽光，日間乾燥酷熱，早上及晚間大致多雲。氣溫介乎28至33度，相對濕度60至90%。
周日大致天晴，日間繼續乾燥酷熱，氣溫28至34度，濕度55至85%。高空反氣旋將於下周初至中期覆蓋廣東，風力微弱，天氣大致良好，內陸地區更可能極端酷熱。
熱帶氣旋蘇力加預料會逐漸增強，移向台灣以東至琉球群島附近海域，其後轉向東北往日本以南海域移動，對本港無直接影響。黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，市民外出須提防中暑。
天文台指，下周後期另一股東北季候風預料影響華南，帶來幾陣驟雨，高溫天氣將稍為紓緩。
